product_metadata.title: 4 Piece Sofa Covers For 3 Cushion Couch Sofa Slipcover Soft Couch Cover For Dogs-Washable Sofa Furniture Covers With 3 Individual Cushion Covers, Feature Jacquard Fabric (3 Cushion Sofa, Dusty Blue)
features: INDIVIDUAL CUSHION COVERS: These creative 4 PIECES sofa covers are sophisticated designed, including 1 piece of base cover and 3 individual cushion pieces. Crafted from 85% Polyester/15% spandex thicken jacquard fabric with small checks pattern. This sofa slipcover will ensure higher elasticity and is more durable than other ordinary cover for its thicken design

PERFECT FIT: Our upgraded jacquard slipcovers are one-size-fits-most. It accommodates sizing variations with universal fit technology including two-way stretch fabric (T-Cushion and Box Cushion). Best fits Large Size 72 to 88-inches wide; X-Large Size 89 to 103-inches wide (outside arm to outside arm, straight across), 31 to 41-inches tall

FULL PROTECTION: This slipcover is exclusive designed for sofas with individual cushions for creating a more custom-upholstered look. The cushion covers with deep elastic hems make a better fit and perfect stretch to all edges, smooth and wrinkle free. By covering cushion separately, more extra fabric can be tuck and require no re-tucking

EFFORTLESS INSTALLMENT: 10 minutes to transform your room in an instant! Fast and easy installation (Installation Instructions Included). Best choice for both leather/fabric furniture, slip on and tuck the extra fabric into the gap between the back and sitting cushions. Innovate your home decor while reflecting the original shape of your furniture

EASY CARE: Machine washable in cold water. Wash separately at gentle cycle. Using mild laundry detergent. Do not bleach and iron. You are welcome to shop more styles of furniture slipcovers in TURQUOIZE shop
